_meta.source: requirements.md s3 (frozen) + EPC2019 datasheet (EPC 2022) + LMG1020 SNOSD45B (TI 2018)
_meta.refdes_note: All ref values are PROVISIONAL - no schematic exists at P1. P2 must remap to the real refdes. Q1=EPC2019, U1=LMG1020, U2=5V buck, L1=RF drain choke, L2=L_s tank inductor 184nH, L3=L_m match inductor 115nH.
_meta.netname_note: Power nets are bare per convention. RF net names (/SW, /TANK, /RFOUT) are PROVISIONAL and must be remapped by P2 to the final netlist names or the entries will silently no-op.

rails.vin: external bench PSU, 40 V DC, >=7 A, via 2-pos screw terminal >=10 A

consumers.what: RF drain choke -> Q1 drain (the 200 W stage)
consumers.basis: (200 W + 35.0 W loss)/40 V at the 85.1% nominal efficiency point; 6.26 A at the 79.8% worst case. Reproduces the frozen 5.8 A.

rails.note: Unregulated, unprotected bus - owner-acknowledged at P0 Q11. Transient overshoot to ~51 V on turn-on (LC ring with cable inductance, power.md s7): every part on this net must be rated >=63 V.

consumers.basis: EPC2019 Qg 2.9 nC max at Vgs 5 V x 20 MHz
LMG1020 I_VDD,op 40 mA typ at 30 MHz / 0.1 pF, scaled to 20 MHz

rails.note: MUST be a buck, not an LDO: an LDO burns (40-5)*0.085 = 3.0 W for a 0.42 W load. Buck spec: Vin 40 V nom / >=63 V abs max, Vout 5.0 V +/-4% (LMG1020 recommends 4.75-5.4 V, abs max 5.75 V, UVLO 4.33 V max rising), Iout >=0.3 A, LCSC-stocked. The 0.3 A budget also covers the two-paralleled-FET option (143 mA). Low average / HIGH PEAK rail: 7 A source peaks with 375 ps rise - see thermal/decoupling notes, loop inductance is the binding spec, not capacitance.

power_constraints.note: 5.88 A nominal / 6.26 A at the 80% efficiency floor, sized 7.0 A with margin; screw terminal and wiring rated >=10 A. DC only - IPC-2152 sizing is valid on this net (approx 2.5-3.0 mm at 1 oz external). Not plane_fed: the path is a short terminal -> bulk -> choke run.

Average current only 85 mA; 0.3 A declared as the budget. Width is not the constraint on this rail - the LMG1020's 7 A / 375 ps peaks require total VDD+gate loop inductance <= 0.3 nH (100 nF X7R 0402 + 10 nF C0G 0201 at the VDD ball, via-in-pad return).

PROVISIONAL NET NAME - Q1 drain / switch node. 9.0 A rms (Class E I_sw,rms = 1.5375 x I_dc), 142.5 V peak. IPC-2152 DC sizing UNDERSTATES this net: at 20 MHz the skin depth is 14.6 um so the AC/DC resistance factor is ~2.5. Binding requirement is ~4.9 mm of poured copper for a <=0.2 W loss budget over a 10 mm run, not the DC width.

PROVISIONAL NET NAME - series tank path L_s / C_s / L_m. 6.58 A rms = sqrt(200/4.614); sees ~215 V peak. Binding requirement is ~6.4 mm of poured copper (<=0.5 W over a 60 mm developed path at an AC/DC factor of 2.5), not DC ampacity.
PROVISIONAL NET NAME - match output to SMA. 2.0 A rms = sqrt(200/50), 100 V rms. Width is set by the 50 ohm controlled-impedance requirement, not by current.

thermal_constraints.note: EPC2019. BINDING CONSTRAINT ON THE BOARD. 8.86 W nominal (conduction 3.24 + Coss hysteresis 2.84 + turn-off 0.70 + ZVS residual 1.98 + gate 0.10), 14.79 W worst case with a max-Rds(on) part. Datasheet RthJB 7.5 C/W alone consumes 66 C of the 85 C junction budget and CANNOT be improved by layout. dt_c 25 = the board land must stay within 25 C of the 40 C ambient. min_vias 20 requires 0.3 mm COPPER-FILLED vias (plated-barrel-only is ~2.5x worse) in and immediately around the source lands, with a soldermask-opened bottom pad. Requires theta_HS <= 0.3 C/W forced-air heatsink. Even so Tj lands at ~138 C against a 125 C target. See power.md s5 and OPEN item 1.

L_s series tank inductor 184 nH. P = 43.35 * (w*L)/Q = 1001/Q watts; 6.7 W at Q=150, 10.0 W at Q=100, 12.5 W at Q=80. NO discrete SMD inductor can dissipate this (theta ~30-50 C/W in forced air). PCB air-core spiral is the primary implementation, not the fallback. Needs plane cutouts on ALL inner layers AND no heatsink coverage beneath it (a metal heatsink under a spiral is a shorted turn). Expect 100-140 C copper - specify high-Tg FR4 (TG155+).

L_m L-match inductor 115 nH. NOT in the frozen loss list - carries the same 6.58 A rms as L_s because it is a series element. P = 626/Q watts; 4.2 W at Q=150, 6.3 W at Q=100, 7.8 W at Q=80. Second hottest item on the board. Same treatment as L2.

RF drain choke. P = 34.2 * DCR; 0.86 W at 25 mohm DCR. Spec: L 0.47-1.0 uH, SRF >= 80 MHz, DCR <= 25 mohm, I_sat >= 12 A, >= 8 A rms. Hard part to source at LCSC - flag to component-scout. Smaller L trades easier sourcing for more bus ripple (absorbed cheaply by the HF C0G bank).

LMG1020. Below the 0.5 W flag threshold but listed because its junction temperature is board-temperature-driven and it must sit 1-2 mm from the hottest part on the board. Use PsiJB 38.3 C/W against the LOCAL board temperature, not RthJA 133.6 C/W: Tj = T_board + 12 C. Safe provided the copper under it stays below ~110 C (recommended Tj max 125 C). 0.32 W = 67% of the 0.29 W gate loop energy + its own 27 mA internal current.

assumptions: Tj design target 125 C for the EPC2019 (25 C derate on the 150 C abs max), 40 C ambient per P0 Q7.

theta_BS (Q1 land -> heatsink base) = 3.0 C/W ASSUMED: >=20 x 0.3 mm copper-filled vias (2.3) + bottom copper spreading (0.7) + mask-opened pad with thin grease TIM over ~40 mm2 (0.5). VERIFY-LATER - this number has not been simulated.
~18 W nominal (27 W worst) enters the bottom heatsink; the balance leaves the top surface into the forced air. Split assumes ~40% of the magnetics loss conducts into the board.
Class E ideal waveforms: I_sw,rms = 1.5375 x I_dc, I_sw,pk = 2.862 x I_dc = 16.7 A (matches the frozen ~16 A).
Coss hysteresis taken as 5/10/15 % of the 1.42 uJ stored energy at 142.5 V. Not vendor-published for the EPC2019; the 10 % nominal is the standard eGaN figure.

Capacitor bank losses (C_s 0.90 W, C_m 0.80 W nominal) adopted from the sibling fragment research/output-network.json, which derives them from tanD on real LCSC C0G parts - higher and better grounded than this agent's first ESR estimate. C_shunt external bank still on an assumed 5/10/25 mohm bank ESR.
AC/DC resistance factor 2.5 on 1 oz copper at 20 MHz (skin depth 14.6 um).

Un-modelled losses taken at +15 % of the modelled subtotal (FR4 dielectric loss at 20 MHz, harmonic currents in the match, parasitic resonances). With this term the bottom-up budget reproduces the frozen band closely: 35.0 W / 85.1 % / 5.88 A nominal and 50.5 W / 79.8 % / 6.26 A worst case, against the frozen 35-50 W / 80-85 % / 5.8 A.
flags_for_p2: CONTRADICTION BETWEEN P1 FRAGMENTS: EPC2019 datasheet Coss(er) is 156 pF, not the 110 pF in the brief -> the external C0G shunt cap should be ~161 pF, not ~200 pF. research/output-network.json picks 4 x 56 pF = 224 pF from the brief's figure, which is 39% high. That fragment flags its pick as a planning default pending P2 simulation, so the two are reconcilable, but P2 must rule. Directly affects ZVS.
EPC2019 die is 2.77 x 0.95 mm with solder bars, not the 1.35 mm square stated in the brief -> footprint and thermal via plan both change.
EPC2019 Rds(on) is 22 mohm typ / 42 mohm MAX at 25 C (~1.8x at 125 C). A max-Rds part pushes Tj to ~203 C and destroys the board. Build-yield risk across the 5-board run.

Floorplan must split into a heatsink zone (Q1, L1, bulk, driver - solid bottom copper, heatsink bolted on) and a magnetics zone (L2, L3, tank caps - all planes cut away, NO heatsink coverage, top-side forced air only). The heatsink footprint must not extend under the spiral inductors.
Specify high-Tg FR4 (TG155 or better) - the spiral inductor copper is expected to run 100-140 C, at the limit of JLC standard FR4.
Layout loop priority: (1) C_shunt/source loop, (2) gate + VDD loop <= 0.3 nH, (3) 40 V bus decoupling. The 40 V rail is NOT in the RF loop - the choke keeps it out.
